name: Dq_tau component
statement: Dq_tau measures hidden vertical drift of the observed time generator, clock branch, time readout and tau-role map, not every private process-time variable.
guard: private traversal/memory time is allowed only if it does not alter observed clock/source/orbit/readout tau

name: q-basic observed tau
statement: If tau_obs=tau_bar(q) is selected before variation and v is in ker(Dq), then delta_v tau_obs=0 and Dq_tau[v]=0.
guard: fails if tau is a hidden-field functional outside q or chosen after residuals are seen

name: same tau across roles
statement: The zero is active only when tau_source=tau_charge=tau_clock=tau_orbit=tau_PPN=tau_readout in the same local branch.
guard: split source, clock, orbital or PPN time choices become R_tau_split

name: fixed reference and surfaces
statement: H_ref is fixed before variation and S_link is fixed or Lie_tau-dragged, so tau drift cannot re-enter through moving surfaces or a fitted reference subtraction.
guard: moving surfaces and post-fit references remain residual rows

name: fixed observed-tau C1 silence
statement: A branch-selected tau_obs(q), fixed units and fixed orientation have zero local derivative along hidden vertical directions in the compact test window.
guard: time-dependent readout maps, lapse rescaling or clock calibration drift reopen C1 bounds

name: global tau theorem guard
statement: 4269 does not prove all MTS private time notions are the same; it only removes the observed-tau Dq component inside the selected q-basic branch.
guard: the 2597 audit remains active outside this local observed-tau selector

name: tau residual fallback
statement: If any tau/source/clock/orbit/frame/readout clause fails, retain epsilon_tau <= |R_tau_lock|/M_H_ref with no cancellation against geometry or boundary rows.
guard: tau residuals must be scored in clock, PPN, orbital and source-charge arenas
